Golden Designs Vorarlberg GDI-8005-01 is a 5 person outdoor traditional sauna with an 8.0 kW stove, Canadian Hemlock, flat roof design, and bronze privacy tempered glass. Built for outdoor use, this sauna pairs a traditional high-heat steam experience with practical comfort features for residential wellness spaces. The 81" x 60" x 87" assembled footprint with overhang gives the cabin room for up to 5 persons, while the 74" x 53" x 81" interior dimensions provide usable seating space without requiring a large structure. Its 8.0 kW stove with built-in controls is designed for traditional sauna temperatures, with an ideal operating range of 170°F to 185°F and heat capability up to 190°F.

The Vorarlberg is built with natural reforested Canadian Hemlock and finished with water proof stain on the exterior, giving it a warm wood appearance suited for patios, decks, and outdoor wellness areas. The bronze privacy tempered glass door keeps the front visually open while adding a more private look than clear glass. Inside, the sauna includes an interior chromotherapy color lighting system, red light therapy feature, interior LED control panel, built-in FM station, Bluetooth connection, and built-in performance speakers. These features support a more complete sauna environment by combining heat, light, and audio controls in one outdoor cabin.

For traditional sauna use, the included sandglass, bucket, and scoop support classic water-over-stone sauna routines when used according to the heater instructions. The sauna ships in 8 boxes and has an assembled weight of 720 lbs, with a listed shipping weight of 985 lbs. Electrical requirements include a 240V / 40AMP service for the stove plus 120V / 15AMP service for the controls, lights, and music, with installation by a certified electrician required for the heater. The owner’s manual also identifies a 120V 15AMP outlet requirement and a dedicated 240V 40AMP circuit requirement for the heater.

Golden Designs focuses on home sauna products that combine wood cabin construction, electric heating, lighting, and user controls for residential wellness spaces. This model is intended for buyers who want a traditional outdoor steam sauna rather than an indoor infrared cabinet, with verified features centered on outdoor placement, Canadian Hemlock construction, traditional high-temperature operation, and integrated comfort controls.
